model_input_contract.cause: The runner read assignment.question instead of joining assignment.task_id to tasks[].question.
model_input_contract.evaluator_behavior: The blind evaluator joined task_id to tasks[].question and therefore graded against a question the model never received.

historical_data_policy: All Runs, Artifacts, Evidence Bundles, Outcome Records, scores, and hashes are retained unchanged; no rerun or substitution is permitted.
interpretation: The raw score matrix is retained for audit only and cannot support Consumption or Effect claims.
resolution: The runner now validates the task-question join before model calls and rejects cached settlement that durable Tape cannot prove. The frozen v0.3 manifest remains unchanged; any rerun requires a new preregistered revision.
